arxiv-2009-02455.title: User-Guided Domain Adaptation for Rapid Annotation from User Interactions: A Study on Pathological Liver Segmentation
arxiv-2009-02455.creator: Ashwin Raju, Zhanghexuan Ji, Chi Tung Cheng, Jinzheng Cai, Junzhou Huang, Jing Xiao, Le Lu, ChienHung Liao, Adam P. Harrison
arxiv-2009-02455.description: Abstract Mask-based annotation of medical images, especially for 3 3 D data, is a bottleneck in developing reliable machine learning models. Using minimal-labor user interactions to guide the annotation is promising, but challenges remain on best harmonizing the mask prediction with the user interactions.

arxiv-2103-15940.title: Representation range needs for 16-bit neural network training
arxiv-2103-15940.creator: 1 st Valentina Popescu, 1 st Abhinav Venigalla, 2 nd Di Wu, 3 rd Robert Schreiber
arxiv-2103-15940.description: Abstract Deep learning has grown rapidly thanks to its state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of real-world applications. While neural networks have been trained using IEEE-754 binary32 arithmetic, the rapid growth of computational demands in deep learning has boosted interest in faster, low precision training.

arxiv-2105-05675.title: Contribution of pressure to the energy-momentum density in a moving perfect fluid: A physical perspective
arxiv-2105-05675.creator: Ashok K. Singal
arxiv-2105-05675.description: Abstract In the energy-momentum density expressions for a relativistic perfect fluid with a bulk motion, one comes across a couple of pressure-dependent terms, which though well known, are to an extent, lacking in their conceptual basis and the ensuing physical interpretation.

arxiv-2109-02238.title: Optimal solutions and ranks in the max-cut SDP
arxiv-2109-02238.creator: Daniel Hong, Hyunwoo Lee, Alex Wei
arxiv-2109-02238.description: Abstract . The max-cut problem is a classical graph theory problem which is NP-complete. The best polynomial time approximation scheme relies on semidefinite programming (SDP). We study the conditions under which graphs of certain classes have rank 1 solutions to the max-cut SDP.

arxiv-2301-07019.title: Observational Constraints and Preheating in Cuscuton Inflation
arxiv-2301-07019.creator: Phongpichit Channuie, Khamphee Karwan, Jakkrit Sangtawee
arxiv-2301-07019.description: Abstract We study cuscuton inflation for the models where the potential of the cuscuton takes quadratic and exponential forms. We find that for the quadratic potential, a scalar spectral index n s n_{s} is not affected by cuscuton at the leading order in the slow-roll inflation models. However, a tensor-to-scalar ratio r r can be suppressed.

arxiv-2302-11792.title: Broadband X-ray Spectroscopy of the Pulsar Wind Nebula in HESS J1640-465 Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2302-11792.creator: Moaz Abdelmaguid, Joseph D. Gelfand, Eric Gotthelf, Samayra Straal
arxiv-2302-11792.description: Abstract We present updated measurements of the X-ray properties of the pulsar wind nebula associated with the TeV γ \gamma -ray source HESS J1640-465 derived from Chandra & NuSTAR data. We report a high N H N_{H} value along line of sight, consistent with previous work, which led us to incorporate effects of dust scattering in our spectral analysis.

arxiv-2304-10674.title: On properties and classification of a class of 4 4 -dimensional 3 3 -Hom-Lie algebras with a nilpotent twisting map
arxiv-2304-10674.creator: Abdennour Kitouni, Sergei Silvestrov
arxiv-2304-10674.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Abdennour Kitouni, Sergei Silvestrov. The aim of this work is to investigate the properties and classification of an interesting class of 4 4 -dimensional 3 3 -Hom-Lie algebras with a nilpotent twisting map α \alpha and eight structure constants as parameters. Derived series and central descending series are studied for all algebras in this class and are used to divide it into five non-isomorphic subclasses. The levels of solvability and nilpotency of the 3 3 -Hom-Lie algebras in these five classes are obtained.

arxiv-2311-10823.title: High precision accelerator for our hybrid model of the redshift space power spectrum 2022 High precision accelerator for our hybrid model of the redshift space power spectrum – C
arxiv-2311-10823.creator: M. Icaza-Lizaola, Yong-Seon Song, Minji Oh, Yi Zheng
arxiv-2311-10823.description: Abstract Upcoming Large Scale Structure surveys aim to achieve an unprecedented level of precision in measuring galaxy clustering. However, accurately modeling these statistics may require theoretical templates that go beyond second-order perturbation theory, especially for achieving precision at smaller scales. In our previous work, we introduced a hybrid model for the redshift space power spectrum of galaxies.

arxiv-2401-16199.title: Optimal quadrature errors and sampling numbers for Sobolev spaces with logarithmic perturbation on spheres
arxiv-2401-16199.creator: Jiaxin Geng, Yun Ling, Jiansong Li, Heping Wang
arxiv-2401-16199.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study optimal quadrature errors, approximation numbers, and sampling numbers in L 2 ​ ( 𝕊 d ) L_{2}({\mathbb{S}}^{d}) for Sobolev spaces H α , β ​ ( 𝕊 d ) {\rm H}^{\alpha,\beta}({\mathbb{S}}^{d}) with logarithmic perturbation on the unit sphere 𝕊 d {\mathbb{S}}^{d} in ℝ d + 1 \mathbb{R}^{d+1} .

arxiv-2411-02812.title: NEOviz: Uncertainty-Driven Visual Analysis of Asteroid Trajectories
arxiv-2411-02812.creator: \authororcid Fangfei Lan0000-0002-8237-5919, \authororcid Malin Ejdbo0009-0005-6870-8552, \authororcid Joachim Moeyens0000-0001-5820-3925, \authororcid Bei Wang0000-0002-9240-0700, \authororcid Anders Ynnerman0000-0002-9466-9826, \authororcid Alexander Bock0000-0002-2849-6146
arxiv-2411-02812.description: Abstract We introduce NEOviz , an interactive visualization system designed to assist planetary defense experts in the visual analysis of the movements of near-Earth objects in the Solar System that might prove hazardous to Earth. Asteroids are often discovered using optical telescopes and their trajectories are calculated from images, resulting in an inherent asymmetric uncertainty in their position and velocity.

arxiv-2412-16591.title: Data-Driven Economic Agent-Based Models ⋆
arxiv-2412-16591.creator: Marco Pangallo and R. Maria del Rio-Chanona
arxiv-2412-16591.description: Abstract Economic agent-based models (ABMs) are becoming more and more data-driven, establishing themselves as increasingly valuable tools for economic research and policymaking. We propose to classify the extent to which an ABM is data-driven based on whether agent-level quantities are initialized from real-world micro-data and whether the ABM’s dynamics track empirical time series.

arxiv-2507-14147.title: Graph Convolutional Neural Networks to Model the Brain for Insomnia
arxiv-2507-14147.creator: Kevin Monteiro (✉), Sam Nallaperuma-Herzberg, Martina Mason, Steve Niederer
arxiv-2507-14147.description: Abstract Insomnia affects a vast population of the world and can have a wide range of causes. Existing treatments for insomnia have been linked with many side effects like headaches, dizziness, etc. As such, there is a clear need for improved insomnia treatment.

pmc-10735350.title: THE HEALTH CARE COSTS OF DEMENTIA FOR MEXICANS AND MEXICAN AMERICANS IN MÉXICO AND THE UNITED STATES
pmc-10735350.creator: Mónika López Anuarbe, Angela Gutierrez
pmc-10735350.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Dementia prevalence and costs affect subpopulations differently, generating healthcare and aging disparities. Most research on healthcare costs associated with dementia has overlooked cross-national comparisons among Hispanics in general and Mexicans in particular. This study utilizes the 2012-2018 Mexican Health and Aging Study (MHAS) and Health and Retirement Study (HRS) to assess: 1) relationships between geographic context and healthcare costs (hospitalization, medical, outpatient, prescription, dental); and 2) whether dementia status moderates the geographic context-healthcare costs relationship.

pmc-10736841.title: STRATEGIES FOR MAINTAINING FIDELITY AND SUSTAINABILITY IN EVIDENCE-BASED PROGRAM DELIVERY
pmc-10736841.creator: Kate Gordon, Carey Wexler Sherman, Kenneth Hepburn
pmc-10736841.description: Federal agencies and advisory councils emphasize the need to expand delivery of evidence-based programs (EBPs) to meet the needs of the increasing millions of family members and friends providing long-term, complex care to persons living with dementias in the U.S. (Alzheimer’s Association, 2022).

pmc-11428389.title: Perfectionism and Emotion Regulation in the Study of Suicidal Ideation in Portuguese Young Adults
pmc-11428389.creator: Marta Brás, João Antunes, Ana Reis, Cláudia Carmo, Xiaochun Xie
pmc-11428389.description: Suicide is a serious public health problem worldwide, being the culmination of a process that normally begins with suicidal ideation. Therefore, it is important to assess suicidal ideation and know its risk factors. The association between perfectionism and suicidal ideation has been widely debated in the literature. However, knowledge about the role of emotion regulation in this relationship is scarce.

pmc-11622374.title: HXK, SnRK1, and TOR signaling in plants: Unraveling mechanisms of stress response and secondary metabolism
pmc-11622374.creator: Seung Hee Eom, Eunhui Kim, Tae Kyung Hyun
pmc-11622374.description: As sessile photoautotrophs, plants constantly encounter diverse environmental stresses. Recent research has focused on elucidating sugar and energy signaling mediated by hexokinase (HXK), sucrose non-fermenting 1-related protein kinase 1 (SnRK1), and the target of rapamycin (TOR) and assessing its intricate interplay with hormones and secondary metabolism. HXK serves as a pivotal regulator of glucose sensing and metabolism.

pmc-11632241.title: Contemporary outcomes of catheter ablation of the structural ventricular tachycardias in severe ischemic and non‐ischemic cardiomyopathies in Turkish population
pmc-11632241.creator: Emir Baskovski, Timucin Altin, Omer Akyurek, Mahmut Ekrem Cunetoglu, Volkan Kozluca, Irem Muge Akbulut, Nail Burak Ozbeyaz, Nazli Turan Serifler, Eralp Tutar
pmc-11632241.description: IntroductionCurrently, there are no data regarding outcomes of the catheter ablation for structural ventricular tachycardia (VT) in Türkiye. In this observational study, we aim to investigate cardiac outcomes of patients undergoing catheter VT ablation at a tertiary center in Türkiye.MethodsThis was a retrospective observational study performed at a single university center.

pmc-11671781.description: been scarce [3,4]. This began to change when the hospital price transparency (HPT) went into effect on January 1, 2021 [5]. pmc-12359765.title: Healthcare workers’ perspectives on integrated oral and antenatal health care at public health facilities in southwestern nigeria: a qualitative study
pmc-12359765.creator: Love Bukola Ayamolowo, Oluwabunmi Samuel Ibitoye, Ayodeji Omobolanle Esan, Folahanmi Tomiwa Akinsolu, George Uchenna Eleje, Abideen Olurotimi Salako, Ifeoma Eugenia Idigbe, Joanne Lusher, Oliver Chukwujekwu Ezechi, Moréniké Oluwátóyìn Foláyan
pmc-12359765.description: BackgroundWomen experience physiological and psychological changes that can affect oral health during pregnancy. This study evaluated the current practices, barriers, and facilitators of oral health care within antenatal care services and assess the feasibility and benefits of integrating oral healthcare into antenatal care frameworks, particularly in Southwest Nigeria.

pmc-12773336.title: Abstract 032: Ovine Models for Cerebral Venous Catheter Access: A Single Center Experience
pmc-12773336.creator: José M Morales, Naoki Kaneko, Gary R Duckwiler
pmc-12773336.description: IntroductionLarge animal models are utilized for preclinical neuroendovascular research, and aid in the characterization and de‐risking of novel therapeutic approaches. To date, only a single prior study has been published providing a detailed account of an ovine model (Corriedale sheep) for cerebral venous access. The generalizability of these experiments has not yet been validated externally.

pmc-12920536.title: Therapeutic potential of combination medicinal mushrooms (NevG) in ischemic stroke: correlating motor function, cognitive recovery, and hippocampal integrity in MCAO rats
pmc-12920536.creator: Nur Athirah Azlan, Misya Afiqah Noor Tuah, Nik Nasihah Nik Ramli, Hussin Muhammad, Zolkapli Eshak, Liao Peng, Chen Bo, Yatinesh Kumari, Imran Jazuli, Che Mohd Nasril Che Mohd Nasir, Syntyche Seow Ling Sing, Cheng Poh Guat, Hafizah Abdul Hamid, Zaw Myo Hein, Muhammad Danial Che Ramli
pmc-12920536.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIschemic stroke is a major neurological disorder that is characterized by cognitive decline and sensorimotor impairment. Despite the potential of therapeutic effects and anti-inflammatory properties of medicinal mushrooms, most current research focuses on single-species effects rather than combined formulations.

pmc-13030849.title: Transient Expression and Immunogenicity Assessment of the Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus Der p 2 Allergen Produced in Nicotiana benthamiana
pmc-13030849.creator: Kotchaporn Jirananon, Kanokporn Thiganta, Kaewta Rattanapisit, Balamurugan Shanmugaraj, Waranyoo Phoolcharoen
pmc-13030849.description: Background: House dust mites (HDM) are one of the significant indoor allergen sources which cause IgE-mediated responses in most of the allergic individuals. HDMs are found in human habitats worldwide and Der p 2 is one of the major clinically relevant HDM allergens involved in triggering allergic diseases.
